reviews.boundary_analysis: The default includes measurement/profiling evidence rather than merely preferring it; BF-0171 already registers this potential strengthening. EF pre-optimization inspection and frontend real-need gating are also explicit prior claims. No new action is inferred merely because the canonical domain says backend.

Never blocking async I/O and never fire-and-forget EF context work are separate registered obligations. DbContext thread safety explains the latter and does not create an unregistered performance-specific exception.

CancellationToken.None is limited to intentionally request-outliving work; propagation through resilience is explicit. Baselines preserve that exception and meaningful-async scope plus the prohibition on gratuitous synchronous parameters.

Clock-dependent deterministic-test default excludes mechanically replacing stored timestamps. Testing specifies injection and FakeTimeProvider, already a prior claim beyond the canonical clock abstraction choice.

Lifetime alternatives are allowed; dynamic request headers cannot mutate shared defaults concurrently while stable headers may be configured. Direct HttpClient construction for handler tests is expressly permitted and registered, not contradicted by the per-request production prohibition.

Entity-needed projection exception, tracking choice, split-query SQL verification and deterministic database pagination are explicit union claims. Prior iterative U0008 (use LINQ for additional predicates/shaping) and U0009 (consider keyset for very large/frequently traversed data) remain potentially independent advisory clauses: canonical database paging and the registered deterministic-ordering clause do not alone settle their normativity or semantic coverage. No duplicate discovery is counted.

Frequent reads alone do not justify caching; performance-only use requires measurement first and consistency semantics precede cache code. Distributed deployment needs and Reserved decision treatment are registered; expiration must follow data semantics and avoid unbounded entries. No automatic Redis/HybridCache mandate inferred.

Measured material compilation overhead, raw-SQL expressibility alternative, measured high-volume logging, verified allocation-tool improvement, and no record-struct allocation fashion are each represented. Raw-string syntax is explicitly not a reason for SQL. These leaf gates are stricter/specific versions of canonical performance guidance but already registered in the union.
